Creates a new campaign in `draft` status on the specified WABA `channelId`.

- `name`: Campaign title.
- `channelId`: Sender WABA channel ID accessible to the API key.
- `segmentId` (optional): Audience segment ID. May be omitted or `null` while `status` is `draft`; required before `schedule`, `send`, `preview`, `validate-variables`, or `cost/forecast`.
- `content`: Choose `mode: "text"` (with `content.text`) or `mode: "template"` (with `content.templateName`, `content.language`, optional `content.messageSendTtlSeconds`, and either `content.variables` + `content.bindings` or raw WABA `content.params`). Combining `params` and `bindings` returns `400`. `content.onMissing` defaults to `skip_recipient`.
- `excludeStoplist` (optional, boolean, default `true`): Suppresses recipients on the channel stoplist at send time; always enforced as `true` for `MARKETING` templates.
- `excludeBlocked` (optional, boolean, default `true`): Excludes contacts with blocked Inbox dialogs on `channelId`.
- `dailyLimit` (optional): Client daily pacing cap (integer `>= 1` stored as `dailyLimitOverride`, or `null` to clear). Values above a numeric channel tier return `400` (`daily_limit_exceeds_tier`).

Canonical template slot keys (`content.variables` and `content.bindings`):

- `header_media_url` — public HTTPS media URL when the template has an `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, or `DOCUMENT` header.
- `header_1..N` — text header placeholders `{{1}}..{{N}}`.
- `'1'..N` (or `'body_1'..N`) — body placeholders `{{1}}..{{N}}`.

info.title: Campaigns API
info.description:
Campaigns API lets you send WhatsApp broadcasts to audience segments on a selected WABA channel.

A segment can contain up to 500 recipients by default. To increase the limit to 10,000, contact us at [hello@1msg.io](mailto:hello@1msg.io). Inbox methods are documented separately under the Inbox API.

Use the API groups in this order: **Segments → Campaigns → Stoplist → Analytics**.

## 1. Segments

Create an audience segment before launching a campaign. Each member requires a `name` and at least one of `phone` (E.164) or `bsuid`.

- **Manual segments (`manual`, default):** Store durable members added via JSON batches or CSV upload, with optional per-member string `attributes` for template variable bindings.
- **Automatic segments (`automatic`):** Store pure Inbox dialog filter `rules` (Inbox-only). `POST /api/v1/campaigns/segments/preview` evaluates rules live, `…/materialize` refreshes the preview member list, and `…/import-from-rules` copies evaluated contacts into a manual segment. Campaign send always re-evaluates automatic rules live into the recipient snapshot.
- **Pure-audience boundary:** Segments define pure audience only. Per-campaign exclusions (`excludeStoplist` and `excludeBlocked`, both defaulting to `true`) are configured on the campaign itself; legacy `exclude` fields on segments are deprecated no-ops kept for backward compatibility.

## 2. Campaigns

Create a draft with a `channelId` your API key can access. `segmentId` is optional while `status` is `draft` and is required before `send`, `schedule`, `preview`, `validate-variables`, or `cost/forecast`.

Per-campaign exclusions:

- `excludeStoplist` (boolean, default `true`): Suppresses recipients on the channel stoplist at send time. Always enforced as `true` for `MARKETING` templates regardless of the campaign flag.
- `excludeBlocked` (boolean, default `true`): Excludes contacts whose Inbox dialog on `channelId` is blocked (`isBlocked = true`) during preview, cost forecast, variable validation, and send.

Set `content.mode` to `text` or `template`:

- **Session text (`text`):** Provide `content.text`. Delivered only to recipients with an open 24-hour customer-care window.
- **Template (`template`):** Provide `content.templateName` and `content.language` (for example `en`), plus either `content.variables` / `content.bindings` or raw WABA `content.params`. Optional `content.messageSendTtlSeconds` sets the delivery TTL in seconds alongside `variables` or `params`.

Canonical template slot keys for `content.variables` and `content.bindings`:

- `header_media_url` — public HTTPS media URL when the template has an `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, or `DOCUMENT` header.
- `header_1..N` — text header placeholders `{{1}}..{{N}}`.
- `'1'..N` (or `'body_1'..N`) — body placeholders `{{1}}..{{N}}`.
- `button_url_0..N` — dynamic URL button suffix values by button index `0..N` (URL-encoded on send).

Scheduling and daily pacing:

- Set `scheduledAt` on `POST …/send` to a future ISO-8601 timestamp with `Z` or a numeric offset (for example `2026-11-01T09:00:00Z`), or omit/`null` to launch immediately.
- `dailyLimit` on create, draft update, and send is an optional client cap (integer `>= 1`, or `null` to clear) stored as `dailyLimitOverride`.
- When the channel tier is numeric, pacing uses the lower of `dailyLimitOverride` and the channel tier; values above the tier return `400` (`daily_limit_exceeds_tier`). The response field `dailyLimit` records the channel tier snapshot captured at send time. Session text inside an open 24-hour window does not count against daily template caps.

## 3. Stoplist

Manage per-channel (WABA) opt-out contacts, custom stop keywords, and suppression settings for campaign sends.

- **Category & campaign rules:** `MARKETING` templates always suppress stoplisted contacts (Meta compliance). For `UTILITY`, `AUTHENTICATION`, and session `text` campaigns, stoplist suppression follows the campaign's `excludeStoplist` setting (default `true`).
- **Suppressed outcome:** Suppressed recipients receive delivery status `suppressed` — not sent, not billed, and counted separately from delivery errors.
- **Keywords:** Protected default stop words (including multi-word phrases such as `darme de baja`) and opt-in words (`start`, `старт`) are seeded automatically. Each channel supports up to 5 custom stop keywords (1–64 characters), matched against normalized whole-message text or button title/payload.

## 4. Analytics

Inspect delivery performance, recipient replies, attributed opt-outs, errors, and campaign cost estimates:

- **Delivery & engagement:** Summary and recipient-level snapshots track `sent`, `delivered`, `read`, `replied`, `suppressed`, `failed`, `skipped`, and `cancelled`, plus attributed opt-outs (`unsubscribedCount`, `unsubscribedShare`, and `unsubscribed=true` recipient filtering).
- **Replies & errors:** Dedicated endpoints return button/text reply feeds and grouped `failed` / `skipped` error reasons (`suppressed` rows are excluded from errors).
- **Cost estimates:** `cost/forecast`, `cost/actual`, `cost/expenses`, and `cost/expenses.csv` report final estimated `total` and per-country `lineTotal` amounts in `USD`, `BRL`, and `RUB`, with `billingRoute` set to `DIRECT_META` (own WABA / BYOW) or `PLATFORM_1MSG` (1msg platform channel). CSV export columns are `campaign_id,channel_id,completed_at,country_code,category,total_usd,total_brl,total_rub`.

## 5. Campaigns webhooks

1MSG sends signed HTTPS webhook events when segments, campaigns, or channel stoplist entries change. Configure your endpoint in **Settings → Developer → Webhooks**.

### Events

- `segment.created` — A segment was created (`action`: `segment_created`).
- `segment.updated` — A segment or its members changed (`action`: `segment_updated`, `segment_deleted`, `member_added`, `member_updated`, `member_deleted`, or `members_replaced`).
- `campaign.created` — A campaign draft was created (`scheduledAt` holds the scheduled instant or `null`).
- `campaign.updated` — A campaign draft was updated (`scheduledAt` holds the scheduled instant or `null`).
- `campaign.status_changed` — Campaign status changed to `draft`, `sending`, `pause`, `completed`, `failed`, or `scheduled`.
- `stoplist.updated` — A channel stoplist entry was added or removed (`action`: `added` or `removed`, `source`: `keyword`, `api`, or `opt_in_clear`, plus `channelId`, `phone` / `bsuid`, and optional `keyword`).

## Authorization

Your API key must include the **Campaigns** scope. Issue a key in **Settings → Developer → API key** and pass it in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer 1msg_live_…
```

warnings.description: Warnings for this preview. Nothing is sent.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO-8601 instant with a Z or a numeric offset, for example 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z. Omit or null to start now. Template sends use the effective daily cap: dailyLimit when set, otherwise the channel tier.

dailyLimit.description: Optional client cap for this campaign. An integer of 1 or more, or null to clear the saved cap. Stored as dailyLimitOverride. Omit on create to leave the cap unset. Omit on update or send to keep the stored cap. Does not write the tier snapshot dailyLimit. A value above the numeric channel tier is rejected with daily_limit_exceeds_tier and max.

scheduledAt.description: New future ISO-8601 instant with a Z or a numeric offset, for example 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z. Required. Only a campaign that is already scheduled can be moved.

phone.description: E.164 phone, for example +15551234567. Send exactly one of phone or bsuid. Does not change campaign status or analytics.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, for example ab.abc123xyz. A trailing @lid is accepted. Send exactly one of phone or bsuid.

name.description: Optional sample recipient name used to resolve segment.name template bindings for this test send. Falls back to phone or bsuid when omitted.

attributes.description: Optional sample attributes used to resolve template bindings for this test send. Same shape as segment member attributes. Does not change the segment.

accepted.description: Always true when the test was accepted.

campaignStatus.description: Campaign status after the test. A test does not change it.

excludedFromAnalytics.description: Always true. This send is left out of analytics.

conversationId.description: Inbox conversation id, or null when the provider did not return one.

messageId.description: Provider message id, or null when the provider accepted the send without an id.

phone.description: E.164 phone. Present when the test was sent to a phone. Exactly one of phone or bsuid is returned.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID. Present when the test was sent to a BSUID. Exactly one of phone or bsuid is returned.

valid.description: True when every segment member can fill all required template slots.

invalidCount.description: Number of members with at least one missing slot.

invalidRecipients.description: Members that still have unresolved required slots after bindings and static variables.

name.description: New title. Send at least one of name, channelId, segmentId, content, dailyLimit, excludeStoplist, or excludeBlocked. Only a draft can be changed.

segmentId.description: Another segment id, or null to clear the draft audience. The new members are copied when you send.

content.description: Replaces the whole content object. Same template and text rules as create.

dailyLimit.description: Optional client cap for this campaign. An integer of 1 or more, or null to clear the saved cap. Stored as dailyLimitOverride. Omit on create to leave the cap unset. Omit on update or send to keep the stored cap. Does not write the tier snapshot dailyLimit. A value above the numeric channel tier is rejected with daily_limit_exceeds_tier and max.

excludeStoplist.description: Suppress recipients on the channel stoplist at send time. Always enforced as true for MARKETING templates.

excludeBlocked.description: Exclude contacts whose Inbox dialog on the campaign channel is blocked.

version.description: Rules document version. Currently only 1 is supported.

channelId.description: Inbox channel id. Required. Automatic segments are Inbox-only (dialogs).

match.description: Combine predicates with AND (all) or OR (any). Defaults to all.

stoplist.description: Deprecated no-op kept for backward compatibility. Configure excludeStoplist and excludeBlocked on the campaign instead.

dialogBlocked.description: Deprecated no-op kept for backward compatibility. Configure excludeStoplist and excludeBlocked on the campaign instead.

description.description: Optional note, up to 2000 characters, or null when none was stored.

memberCount.description: How many people are in the segment. For automatic this is the last materialized member count (may be 0).

phone.description: E.164 phone, for example +15551234567. Required when bsuid is omitted.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, for example ab.abc123xyz. A trailing @lid is accepted and stored without it. Phone or BSUID is required.

attributes.description: Flat JSON object of string key-value pairs for per-recipient data. Max 50 keys, key up to 64 chars matching [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*, value up to 1024 chars, total JSON up to 10KB. Used with template variable bindings.

row.description: 1-based CSV row number. 0 means a file-level error.

column.description: Column name when the error is column-specific.

sent.description: Share of recipients counted as sent, delivered, or read.

delivery.description: Share of recipients counted as delivered or read.

read.description: Share of recipients counted as read.

click.description: Share of recipients who clicked a button.

failed.description: Share of recipients counted as failed.

id.description: Button id from the template reply.

title.description: Button title, or the button id when no title was stored.

clicks.description: How many times this button was clicked.

uniqueClicks.description: How many recipients clicked this button.

phone.description: Phone in E.164, or null when the recipient is stored by BSUID.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, or null when the recipient is stored by phone.

conversationId.description: Inbox conversation id, or null when none is linked.

providerConversationId.description: Provider chat id: phone digits plus @c.us, otherwise the BSUID plus @lid, or null.

messageId.description: Provider message id, or null before the provider accepts the send.

sentAt.description: When the message was sent, or null.

deliveredAt.description: When the message was delivered, or null.

readAt.description: When the message was read, or null.

replies.description: Replies from this recipient, oldest first.

error.description: Error details, or null when the recipient has no error code, title, or failed time. When present, code, title, and failedAt are always included.

code.description: Provider or skip error code, or null when none was stored.

title.description: Error title, or null when none was stored.

failedAt.description: When the send failed or was skipped, or null when no time was stored.

unsubscribedAt.description: When this recipient was attributed as unsubscribed for this campaign (channel stoplist audit added after send, within the next-campaign-or-24h window), or null.

type.description: button for a template quick reply, or text inside the 24-hour window.

buttonId.description: Button id, or null for a text reply.

text.description: Reply text or button title, or null when none was stored.

phone.description: Phone in E.164, or null when the recipient is stored by BSUID.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, or null when the recipient is stored by phone.

conversationId.description: Inbox conversation id, or null when none is linked.

providerConversationId.description: Provider chat id: phone digits plus @c.us, otherwise the BSUID plus @lid, or null.

messageId.description: Provider message id of the reply.

reason.description: Stored error reason. Groups without a reason are omitted.

code.description: Provider or skip error code, or null when none was stored.

title.description: Error title, or null when none was stored.

type.description: failed is a provider failure. skipped was not sent.

share.description: Share of all campaign recipients in this group, from 0 to 1, rounded to 4 decimal places.

recipients.description: Recipients in this group, up to recipientsLimit.

hasMore.description: True when more recipients share this reason than recipientsLimit returned.

total.description: Final estimated delivered cost for this country in USD, BRL, and RUB.

usd.description: USD amount. Cabinet primary currency. Decimal string from the rate card scale.

brl.description: BRL amount from the list-rate row. Not converted from USD.

rub.description: RUB amount. USD × rubPerUsd stored on the rate-card version.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or OTHER when the phone country cannot be resolved.

recipientCount.description: Recipients in this country. Forecast line cost uses this count (everyone is assumed delivered).

deliveredCount.description: Recipients whose deliveryStatus is delivered. Read does not count. Forecast reports this for information and still prices recipientCount. Actual prices this count.

lineTotal.description: Final estimated cost for the line in USD, BRL, and RUB.

mode.description: template sends a WABA template. text sends session text and only reaches people inside the 24-hour window.

templateName.description: WABA template name. Required when mode is template.

language.description: Template language code, for example en or pt_BR. Required when mode is template.

variables.description: Flat template slot values: numeric keys ("1", "2", … or "body_1") fill BODY {{N}}; "header_1", "header_2", … fill text HEADER {{N}}; "header_media_url" sets the media URL for IMAGE/VIDEO/DOCUMENT headers; "button_url_0", … fill dynamic URL button suffixes. Ignored when params is set.

params.description: Preferred template fill. The same array sendTemplate accepts. Each item is a component with type (header, body, button, carousel, or a newer WABA type). The array is forwarded as-is, including a header image link. When this is set, variables is ignored. An empty array is valid.

messageSendTtlSeconds.description: How many seconds WhatsApp keeps trying to deliver this template. Same field as sendTemplate messageSendTtlSeconds. It sits beside params, not inside the params array. Omit it to use the template default.

bindings.description: Maps template slot keys to data source refs. Only works with the variables path (not params). Keys follow the same format as variables: numeric ("1" or "body_N") for body, header_N, header_media_url, button_url_N. Values are source references like segment.name or segment.attributes.<key>. When set alongside params, returns 400.

onMissing.description: What to do when a binding cannot be resolved for a recipient. skip_recipient (default): skip the recipient and record the reason.

text.description: Session text. Required when mode is text. Not counted against the channel tier.

mode.description: Session text sent only inside the 24-hour window.

text.description: Session text body. Empty when none was stored.

templateName.description: WABA template name. Empty when none was stored.

language.description: Template language code. Empty when none was stored.

params.description: Template params stored for sendTemplate. Each item is a string or an object.

messageSendTtlSeconds.description: Seconds WhatsApp keeps trying to deliver this template. Omitted when the template default is used.

templateName.description: WABA template name. Empty when none was stored.

language.description: Template language code. Empty when none was stored.

variables.description: Flat template placeholders. Present when params were not stored.

messageSendTtlSeconds.description: Seconds WhatsApp keeps trying to deliver this template. Omitted when the template default is used.

sent.description: Recipients with delivery status sent, delivered, or read.

delivered.description: Recipients with delivery status delivered or read.

replied.description: Distinct recipients with at least one reply on this campaign.

errors.description: Recipients with delivery status failed, skipped, or suppressed.

missingSlots.description: Required template slots that could not be filled for this member.

value.description: Value shape depends on field/op (string, boolean, or string array).

type.description: button for a template quick reply, or text inside the 24-hour window.

buttonId.description: Button id, or null for a text reply.

text.description: Reply text or button title, or null when none was stored.

messageId.description: Provider message id of the reply.

phone.description: Phone in E.164, or null when the recipient is stored by BSUID.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, or null when the recipient is stored by phone.

conversationId.description: Inbox conversation id, or null when none is linked.

messageId.description: Provider message id, or null when the send did not get one.

providerConversationId.description: Provider chat id: phone digits plus @c.us, otherwise the BSUID plus @lid, or null.
